# Description

Fixes #(issue)

## Scope

This repository is maintained as a close WotLK 3.3.5a port of upstream Cell. Changes are easiest to review when they fix this WotLK port, improve 3.3.5a compatibility, or port existing upstream Cell behavior.
Maintainer policy: if a feature does not exist in upstream Cell, it is not accepted in this WotLK port. Please propose new feature ideas upstream first at [enderneko/Cell](https://github.com/enderneko/Cell).
- [ ] This change fixes a bug in the WotLK port
- [ ] This change is required for WotLK 3.3.5a compatibility
- [ ] This change ports existing upstream Cell behavior
- [ ] This change was discussed with the maintainer before implementation
- [ ] This change is not a port-only custom feature

## Type of change

Please delete options that are not relevant.

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] Upstream behavior port (ports existing upstream Cell behavior)
- [ ] WotLK compatibility fix
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] This change requires a documentation update
